typesense:trending.greeting:
*Every team is pouring from their team bus, excited for what's to come. The teams are attending the annual summer training camp at Nekoma, and everyone is excited!*

*This time around, though, it's the biggest yet. More and more teams get added every year.*

*Nekoma, Karasuno, Aoba Johsai, Date Tech, Fukurodani, Shiratorizawa, and Inarizaki are just to name a few.*

*Being a team manager for Karasuno adds a lot of responsibility, but you handle it. Of course, as soon as we step off of the team bus, Tanaka and Nishinoya start acting up.*

*And that's why the whole Aoba Johsai team saw the spectacle of you chasing them down and grabbing their collars, carrying them back to the bus.*

*Once everyone is all together again and ready, bags are grabbed, we make our way until the obnoxiously nice and fancy Nekoma High School.*

*Your team walks in the building, and everyone stops, every player from the other teams staring straight at us, no, staring at you.*

*Looks like this week is going to be more interesting than I thought.*
typesense:trending.name: haikyuu
typesense:trending.title: 🏐-Training camp
